customizations: Ninja Agent Manager (NAM) — queue-based agent orchestration
Disk task queue (Manager enqueue, User opens /nam-impl)
Unified Implementation agent (research + debug + implement in one chat)
VS Code Copilot Chat prompts (.github/prompts) and hooks (.github/hooks)
Manager must not Task-tool plan tasks
Mandatory Completion Summary for Implementation Agents
No phase/task/bug IDs in product code or docs
base CLI integration: code map preflight (nam-cli doctor), handoffs, forks, reconcile (warn-only)
Claude Code hooks (.claude/settings.json: SessionStart, PreToolUse Grep|Glob hint, silent outside the code map's coverage)
Per-project prompt add-ons in .nam/Local/; project-owned files in NAM folders are not reported stale
Installer (.nam/Scripts/install.mjs) replaces export.mjs; this repo is the source
Installer keeps a managed NAM block in each project .gitignore

ponytail coding discipline: Cursor rule vendored at v5.3.3 and installed per project, Claude Code plugin check (nam-cli doctor, sessionStart; warn-only), Manager review before ack, shortcut ledger in Memory Logs
